explain.text: Wind favoured cold water for most of the past 3 days, but it has swung back onshore in the last 12 hours. Under PierBite's wind model, a recent shift like that can push cold water away from the pier before it arrives, so the score is held down. This pier has no wind sensor of its own, so the reading comes from Manitowoc Airport.
